import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*np.cos(p[3]*t) + p[2]*np.sin(p[3]*t) + p[4]*x
            + p[5]*v + p[6]*np.log(v) + p[7]*np.sqrt(v)
            + p[8]*x*np.log(v) + p[9]*x*np.sqrt(v))
